subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single blue-haired whale-themed anime maid depicted in the multiple views of <Picture 1>. These views show the same character, not different people. Her identity includes blue eyes, long wavy deep-blue hair fading to light cyan at the ends, a curved hair tuft, fin-shaped side features, a white frilled maid headpiece, blue bows, a navy-and-white maid dress with gold details, a white whale-emblem apron, and a blue whale tail. Use the views together to maintain consistent facial features, hairstyle, costume, anatomy, and illustrated art style.
<Subject 2> is the performance of the short-haired man wearing the dark fur-collared outerwear in <Video 1>. It defines the replacement target's screen position, head and body orientation, facial expressions, gaze, mouth movements, gestures, and timing.
<Video 1> is the source video to be edited, defining the original framing, camera behavior, environment, lighting relationships, props, and chronological shot structure.
<Audio 1> is the synchronized original soundtrack of <Video 1>, to be reused unchanged.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Replace only the man defined by <Subject 2> with <Subject 1>, including his face, hair, neck, visible body, and clothing. Preserve his original performance and the source video's composition, camera behavior, background, props, and timing. Reuse <Audio 1> without modification.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (throughout the replacement): fully_preserved - preserve the reference character's identity, face, hair colors, maid headpiece, costume, accessories, and illustrated art style.
<Subject 2> (throughout the source performance): fully_preserved - transfer the original performer's movements, head turns, gaze, expressions, mouth movements, and action timing to the replacement character.
<Video 1> (throughout): partially_preserved - replace the selected man's appearance and clothing while preserving the source framing, camera behavior, background, props, shot order, and playback speed.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - reuse the complete original soundtrack as the final audio track.

detailed_description:
Preserve the source video's live-action environment while rendering only the replacement character in the illustrated anime style of <Picture 1>. Match the direction and relative intensity of the source lighting on the character without changing her intrinsic hair, skin, or costume colors.

[Shot 1] Preserve the source's close framing of the performer against the gray background. From the first frame, <Subject 1> occupies the original man's position and follows <Subject 2>'s performance. Replace the original human face, short dark hair, fur collar, and visible outerwear with the corresponding visible parts of the reference character. Keep her recognizable blue eyes, blue-to-cyan wavy hair, white frilled headpiece, blue bows, and navy-and-white maid costume consistent as her head changes orientation.

Follow the source performance in chronological order: retain its downward and sideways looks, subsequent head turns, changes in expression, and speaking mouth movements at their original times. Keep the dark foreground prop where it appears in the source, including its movement and its overlap with the mouth and face. Preserve the original foreground-to-background occlusion order.

Maintain the original camera distance, viewing angle, perspective, framing, and movement. Adapt the reference character's anatomy to the source pose while keeping her head and visible body at the corresponding screen scale. The close framing remains a close shot; costume details, legs, apron emblem, or tail appear only if their anatomical positions naturally enter the original frame. Do not widen the shot or move the character to display the full design.

Any source cuts retain their original timing and composition. Preserve the background, existing subtitles, and all objects outside the replaced performer. The replacement remains the same character throughout, with no return to the original man's face or fur clothing. Do not display the reference sheet, its white background, multiple character views, or additional copies of the character.

overall_soundscape:
Reuse <Audio 1> unchanged, preserving the original dialogue, voice, ambience, sound effects, timing, and synchronization. Do not create a new voice or additional sounds.

non_diegetic_music:
Retain any music already present in <Audio 1> unchanged. Add no new music.

## 跟随驱动视频全部帧数版
364设置frame_load_cap=0、skip_first_frames=0、select_every_nth=1，完整读取并转换到24fps。实际加载帧数N经365对齐为17k+5生成长度；367从第0帧保留N帧，再以24fps保存并回贴原音轨。关闭trim_to_audio，避免短音轨截短画面。
这里的总帧数是转成24fps后的帧数；非24fps原文件的原始帧数可能不同，保持原时长优先。H3参考节点仍可能向下裁剪不足一个网格的尾部参考，输出裁剪并不解决尾部动作参考缺失。此版未实跑，不是长视频分段方案；参考视频建议2–15秒，长片需分段，生成length上限3600且受显存限制。不足5帧的输入仍会报错，必须先确认实际视频加载成功。
上传原视频与两个不同角色参考图，替换提示词衣着占位符。尺寸仍由115控制，匹配源视频比例。第三图未连接；Turbo和BlockSparse保持旁路。
